selection: Leave-one-fold-out cross-validation over official folds 1-4; fold 5 held out. Threshold: highest recall flagging at most 20% of alert windows in the pooled out-of-fold predictions.
notes: 2026-11-08: a preliminary 19-subject run selected on the fold-4 validation subjects alone scored test ROC-AUC 0.660. The selection procedure was then changed to cross-validation over folds 1-4 and an identity-free feature subset was added as a candidate. Those choices were made by cross-validation on folds 1-4 only, but the three fold-5 test subjects had been seen once, so treat their scores as slightly optimistic.

2026-11-08: a 20-subject run with an F1-optimal threshold flagged 53% of alert test windows. The threshold rule was changed to cap false alarms at 20% of alert windows on the development folds, before the final run.

cross_subject.protocol: Leave one official fold out; configuration and threshold fixed from train/val. The test fold is included here, so this confirms stability and is not a second untouched estimate.
